producthunt.name: DeepCell
producthunt.tagline: Your deadline survival kit for office work
producthunt.description: Deepcell can help you with deadline tasks that require narrations, calculation and presentation at the same time, such as modeling, sales review, budget forecast and monthly report. DeepCell (both web app and agent plug-in) can create ready-to-use docs, spreadsheets, and slides—with sources and cheat sheets to help you explain. Furthermore, every edit can update related parts. The product is built on a newly designed document format (.deepcell), which is especially designed for system two tasks.

producthunt.name: Claude Duet
producthunt.tagline: Proactive agent that understands what needs your attention
producthunt.description: Claude Duet is a helpful, proactive agent you hand off work to through messages. Tell it what you need and it works on its own computer in the cloud, using apps you connect. It messages you when it is done or needs a decision from you. While it’s always on, it uses good judgment when it reaches out and knows what can wait.

producthunt.name: Doneas
producthunt.tagline: A daily accountability call with other entrepreneurs.
producthunt.description: Doneas helps solo builders stay focused, accountable, and productive. Plan your week every Monday, join a 15-minute daily accountability call with five other builders, and track everything you ship on your public progress page. Plan less. Focus better. Ship more.
